sources.note: Main website describing Carbon Health as urgent/primary care provider with 80+ locations. Details services (urgent care, primary care, virtual care, mental health, pediatrics), insurance acceptance, mobile app.

CarbyOS product site describing four modules: Care (EHR), Health (patient app), Operate (operations), Billing (RCM). Claims 1M+ patients, 1,200+ providers, 200+ locations. Details AI capabilities including SOAP note generation, coding, scheduling, referrals.

ONC certification disclosures for CarbyOS EHR 3. Lists certification criteria, EHI export details (C-CDA for clinical, PDF for billing), MFA details, FHIR API info, DataMotion as dependent software. States psychotherapy notes excluded from export.

Detailed description of Carby Billing (RCM) module. Covers real-time eligibility verification, automated patient responsibility calculation, credit card processing, AI-driven coding suggestions, claims scrubbing rules engine, batch claim correction. Confirms billing is integrated into EHR ecosystem.
Blog post about AI-driven EHR development philosophy. Focused on hands-free charting feature. Mentions clinical decision support and prescribing workflows but minimal detail on other modules.
AI charting announcement. References EHR data including lab visits, diagnostic codes, billing codes, patient history as inputs. Mentions care plan generation with patient summaries.

June 2023 press release announcing AI charting launch across 600+ clinicians. Describes GPT-4 integration, EHR data combination with transcripts, SOAP note auto-generation. States telemedicine, billing, scheduling, messaging, and orders all in same platform.
December 2022 article about Carbon Health's plans to license proprietary EHR to external practices. Limited technical details but confirms strategic intent to become EHR vendor.
February 2026 coverage of Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing. Reports ~93 clinics, 1,400 employees, ~480 providers, $100M+ debt, dual-track restructuring process.
Coverage of Chapter 11 filing with details on $19.5M DIP financing, bid deadline March 6, 2026, operations continuing during restructuring.

Accessed via search results (page itself returned 403). Founded 2015 by Eren Bali, Tom Berry, Greg Burell. 2018 merger with Direct Urgent Care (Caesar Djavaherian). Funding history: seed through $350M Series C (Blackstone). CEO transition Aug 2024.

Attempted to access but got 403. Search snippet listed features: one-touch check-in, triage, template charting, e-prescriptions, lab requesting, imaging, referral management, patient portal with video visits and messaging.
LinkedIn product page for Carby, built by Carbon Health. Found via search but not directly accessed for content.
